subject: science
title: Muscles and joints
canDo: I can explain how muscles work in pairs to move bones at joints.

subject: science
title: Teeth and keeping them healthy
canDo: I can name the types of teeth, say what each does and explain how to care for them.

subject: science
title: Habitats and adaptation
canDo: I can explain how living things suit their habitats and how people change habitats.

subject: science
title: Grouping living things with keys
titleId: Mengelompokkan makhluk hidup dengan kunci determinasi
canDo: I can sort animals into groups and use a key to identify a living thing.

subject: science
title: Food chains
canDo: I can read and build food chains using producer, consumer, predator and prey.

subject: science
title: Solids, liquids and gases
canDo: I can describe solids, liquids and gases and sort materials by their state.

subject: science
title: Melting, freezing, evaporating and condensing
canDo: I can explain melting, freezing, evaporation and condensation and read a thermometer.

subject: science
title: Simple circuits
canDo: I can build a complete circuit and explain how a switch turns it on and off.

subject: science
title: Conductors and insulators
titleId: Konduktor dan isolator panas serta listrik
canDo: I can sort materials into thermal and electrical conductors and insulators.

subject: science
title: How sound is made and travels
canDo: I can explain that sounds are made by vibrations that travel through materials to my ears.

subject: science
title: Pitch and volume
titleId: Tinggi rendah dan keras lemah bunyi
canDo: I can explain how to change the pitch and the volume of a sound.

subject: science
title: Earth, Sun and Moon
canDo: I can explain day and night and describe how the Earth and Moon move.

subject: science
title: Variables, line graphs and conclusions
canDo: I can name the variables in a test, read results and write a conclusion.

subject: science
title: Particles in solids, liquids and gases
titleId: Partikel pada zat padat, cair, dan gas
canDo: I can use the particle model to explain why solids, liquids and gases behave differently.

subject: science
title: Energy and energy transfers
canDo: I can say where energy is found, that it is transferred and never used up, and why some is wasted.

subject: science
title: The Solar System
canDo: I can say what is in the Solar System and that the Sun is at its centre.

subject: science
title: Medicines, germs and keeping healthy
canDo: I can say how medicines and vaccines help, why germs spread disease, and why movement keeps us healthy.
